scope: Storage compatibility milestone, not full ECL conformance. Packing and corpus measurements ran serially on one CPU with a 1 GiB limit, through a Windows Docker bind mount. Filesystem caches were not dropped; container hashes were read before query timing. Charged memory covers the container, not the host or entire Docker VM. Independent RF2 checks overlapped other correctness work: their timing is not a performance comparison. Ontoserver answers are retained version-pinned references, not fresh API requests. Known term-scope and negation differences remain. Decoded runtime columns are unchanged; mmap, narrow widths, bounded description access and remaining ECL semantics are still required.
